d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with choppy bangs frames a mature, youthful face with sharp, narrow deep red eyes. The slender build is clad in a dark crimson military-style outfit featuring a high-collared jacket with gold buckles, matching tight-fitting trousers, and a long, flowing crimson cape with silver metallic trim. A glowing blue orb of energy is held in the right hand, while the figure stands atop floating jagged dark brown rock fragments.
